To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the deflection of MC propagation is mainly due to the interaction of MCs and interplanetary shocks, and the deflection angle depends on the shock intensity and initial propagation orientation of MCs and shocks.

the deflection of an MC body is a consequence of the oblique interaction between an MC and an interplanetary shock, and that the shock intensity and the angular difference between the eruption orientations of the MC and shock determine the deflection angle of MC body.

1) the deflected MC propagation is a natural consequence of the interaction between an MC and an interplanetary strong shock in OC; 2) the deflected deflection of MC body is a result of the shock's passage through the MC body; 3) the deflection of MC is a function of the shock's intensity, the angular difference between the two disturbances and the penetration location of the shock.
